notes.title: Dev Log 09.24.25
notes.content: [p]Today we’ll go over the rest of the machines that will be available in Reel Life in the coming weeks. These machines will help you melt, freeze, spool, and more! Since we went over the mechanics of machines in the last dev log, we’ll skip that and just explain the functions of each remaining machine.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/778d650c7571dfc6b1e76f165500ee78ed149c4b.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the loom’n’spinner. This is the machine you’ll be using to create thread and yarn from wool and organic fibers (like flax). Once you’ve gotten that yarn piled up, run it through again to create fabric![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/ea75b9af525d012729faf97ac8f19200d6b7a897.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the smelt’n’form that will let you – of course – smelt ores and sand! Create ingots of iron, silver, and gold and glass panes for crafting new buildings. You’ll also be able to form bricks in the smelter from clay. If it needs to be fired, this is the machine to do it.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/ce5ee4f5f57f15514e4e7de61af22c1cab9c57f4.png"][/img][/p][p]Next up is the still’n’mix. This machine is used to create delicious spirits! Scotch, brandy, vodka, and rum are among the recipes available to you upon purchase of the machine. Helpful if you want to make your own liquor for gifting or just selling.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/f2164abacca0c2a41584b08af27843f343b5c0c9.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, we have the tumble temper. This is a fun cooking machine that can help you create ingredients – like cream, butter, or mayonnaise – or food – like yogurt and ice cream! It can even be used to make extra animal feed from wheat, corn, and sunflowers (animals need a balanced diet, too!).[/p][p] [/p][p]Of course, these are only some of the recipes that will be available per machine on purchase. We hope you’ll have fun making them all![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for the rest of the machines. [b]We’ll be off for the next two weeks because of a move (and we need to settle in and get back to work), but we’ll be back on 10.14 with more content![/b][/p]

notes.title: Dev Log 09.17.25
notes.content: [p]Today we’ll be looking at a few of the crafting machines that will be in Reel Life. Machines differ from benches in that they will craft on their own while you’re out and about in the world of Reel Life.[/p][p] [/p][p]First up is the composter – the machine you’ll need to use if you want to make fertilizer yourself![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/c8308addf9452c71984262b30e86649daf0e582e.png"][/img][/p][p]To make fertilizer, all you need to do is gather up all of the spoiled food and garbage in your inventory and deposit it into the composter’s inventory box. Click the ‘on’ button and away we go! In 5 days you’ll have a brand new batch of fertilizer.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/b96b822fd6526c613396ae719ca0f9e3c379c887.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ll need at least 10 spoiled food or garbage for one bag of fertilizer, so make sure you don’t throw that precious refuse away![/p][p] [/p][p]Next up is the Mash’n’Heater, a very important machine if you’re going to be doing a lot of cooking and baking.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/5625bbdb8af5f21b15acdd445dce966ee2946ff2.png"][/img][/p][p]Like the composter, you’ll place ingredients in the inventory box for the recipe that you want to craft. To view all of the recipes available to you on each machine, click on the recipe button in the top left of the machine’s GUI.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/5dccf6676bae93049ef6289a887547c211bda945.png"][/img][/p][p]Here we can see all of the recipes available to us! We can craft flour, cooking oil, jams, juices, and nut butters! When you’ve found the recipe you want to use, make use of the ingredients involved and then deposit them into the inventory box.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/58ac5f6155dfcdb3e61c149f2f9d5f2a71b7d0b0.png"][/img][/p][p]Next, depending on the recipe, you may need to turn the heat function on or off. If you’re not sure whether you need to, check the output section of the machine’s GUI. If the output shows up like you want – jam, juice, etc. – you don’t need to do anything – you’re ready to go! If an unexpected output shows up or nothing at all, try click on the heat button and the expected output should show up.[/p][p][/p][p]Moving on, let’s take a look at oak barrels. There are three sizes of oak barrels available for purchase and crafting: regular, large, and giant.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/fdba286ebc977551f66026b3b37bf4627668c4b2.png"][/img][/p][p]Each barrel will hold more inventory for processing than the last, saving you time if you want to craft large batches in one go.[/p][p] [/p][p]Oak barrels are used for fermentation. Pickle eggs, herring, asparagus, or sauerkraut; or try your hand at brewing! Mead, beer, wine, liqueurs, cider, rum, whiskey, and more! If you’re an aspiring home chef, oak barrels can also be used to produce yeast, vinegar, and fish sauce. Just check the recipes to see what you need and how long fermentation will take.[/p][p] [/p][p]Now let’s talk automation. Like we said, machines go to work crafting without your input, but they won’t craft continuously on their own. Once a product has been rendered, you’ll need to remove the output and place more inputs if you want to keep processing.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/020ad9fd001067011bfd0f1cd0178f0630d9b08d.png"][/img][/p][p]Enter the auto feeder and auto keeper! Place the refrigerated auto feeder to the left of any machine to automatically feed inputs into that machine. You’ll still need to manually remove the output before it can get to work, though.[/p][p] [/p][p]That’s where the auto keeper comes into play. Place the refrigerated auto keeper to the right of any machine to have output instantly collected when finished processing! It’s easy to become a jam or jerky mogul with these two assistant machines in play.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lastly, we’re going to look at the most exciting machine to be added in our crafting update: the tokenizer.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/298d2525f57384fbb73af58b1b1cb537a6556615.png"][/img][/p][p]Use this machine to create crop tokens! That means that you can finally grow those increased crop grades and rare crops that you win from time to time. Also use this machine to convert select forage into growable crops. If the forage has a grade (B, A, S) it can be converted into a graded token.[/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for today’s Reel Life insight and we hope to see you again next week when we go over the rest of the machines that will be in the game![/p]

notes.title: Dev Log 09.10.25
notes.content: [p]Continuing on with the crafting benches in Reel Life, we’ll go over what crafting will look like in real time today.[/p][p] [/p][p]Crafting may change slightly in practice between the different benches. For example, with the carpentry and cooking benches (the benches you’ll initially have access to), badges will differ. If you recall, badges determine which recipes you have the skill to craft (inspired by the Sims 2 crafting capabilities).[/p][p] [/p][p]Badges in the carpentry bench range from woodworking to sewing, and some projects in the future may require more than one badge for completion. Meanwhile in the cooking bench, badges (or skills) are limited to cooking and baking. Some recipes require the cooking skill and some require the baking, but for right now, they never cross over.[/p][p] [/p][p]Here’s a look at the cooking process:[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="YQTMrsWL8Zc;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]In the crafting bench you can also refine materials (for instance, logs into lumber). You don’t need any skill levels to refine materials and you don’t need to spend any extra time crafting them. Materials are created instantly according to the quantity you want to produce.[/p][p] [/p][p]If you want to craft anything else, though, you’ll have to invest materials AND time. Time to completion is measured in minutes and that time can be hefty sometimes. To make this a little less tedious, we added a fast forward function when crafting – up to x 4 speed.[/p][p] [/p][p]Now here’s a look at the crafting process:[/p][p] [/p][previewyoutube="4XNJTB-s7HE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The stamina bar is placed in the crafting menu GUI so that you can be sure your player won’t faint while doing all this work. If you’re running out of energy when crafting and need to take a food break, just press the Esc key to exit the crafting process. After eating (or doing anything else, really), you can come back later and finish your project![/p][p] [/p][p]Next week we’ll start looking at the machines you’ll have access to, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Dev Log 09.03.25
notes.content: [p]We’re hard at work on our initial crafting offering and want to give you a little preview of what that entails.[/p][p] [/p][p]There will be two crafting modes in the game: benches and machines. Machines, after receiving input, will craft on their own while you’re off playing slot machines or wooing residents. While machines are for producing (producing ingots, pickles, or tokens, for example), benches are for crafting and will take time to create.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/62ba2fed8a30f89495ac1dd52e04f7c96d0ffccf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here’s two benches placed inside a house. The cooking station bench is white and to the left. The carpentry bench is blue and to the right. Let’s just look at the carpentry bench for right now. Clicking on the bench will bring up this menu:[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/8375da3974abec2dffe2ca0c6333d71c3d23445a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From here, you can select the item you want to craft – provided you can craft it. There will be a multitude of badges in the crafting process that will determine if you have the skill required to craft an object. For our initial release, you’ll only be able to level your woodworking and cooking badges. There are 5 levels of badges and 5 levels of recipes.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/ba05ab8454152988e09da14ea66cbb08d956457d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Before you can craft this giant oak barrel, for example, you’ll need to be a master woodworker with a level 5 badge! To build skill in badges, you’ll need to craft applicable items. For woodworking, that would be furniture, décor, benches, and machines (but you’ll only be able to craft the two latter to start with). This will make it much easier to collect any furniture you’re after (provided you have the recipe) and much cheaper to collect any machines! Just make sure you have enough time in the day to work on your woodworking projects.[/p][p] [/p][p]Project length is measured in game minutes. If you don’t complete a project in one go, the game will remember where you left off (that is, how many minutes you have left to completion!). So as long as you have the time and ingredients, you have access to an infinite supply of craftables![/p][p] [/p][p]Right now you’ll only be able to craft materials, benches, and machines at the carpentry station. We’ll talk all about the machines in a future post and revisit the benches in more detail later on.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Log 08.27.25
notes.content:
[p]As we approach our roll out of the additions mentioned in the last log, we thought it would be fun to take a look at the livestock in Reel Life for a bit.[/p][p] [/p][p]We currently plan to have at least one unique livestock animal in each country (e.g., bison, camels, pigs, etc.). Before we can get to the fun animals, though, we need to establish a foundation. Rosenvale’s livestock are the basic farming sim trio: chickens, sheep, and cows.[/p][p] [/p][p]Traditionally (in Harvest Moon and other farming sims), the impetus to own and raise these animals is mainly money or items for gifting or cooking. Of course, if you like having cute animals around, that’s another good reason![/p][p] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/61a5e0e6fb8508371e4ef661595486abe41cf0eb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Our original chicken design wasn’t very cute, so we worked hard on updating it to where having chickens on your farm might bring a smile to your face.[/p][p] [/p][p]Tradition also dictates perhaps one special color of animal per animal type, though this isn’t as common as it once was. Now it’s common to find livestock in all sorts of colors for variety, and Reel Life is no exception.[/p][p] [/p][p]Right now, there are three basic colors of each animal to collect. But we’ve been working on a lot more![/p][p] [/p][p]First are common colors…[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/5aa77f0e32c4a0ba25988756ef49b392f321f68d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/b0a74c8b7e5eb88a90b3d6c431811decce107e17.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/308e7fae3d0d8d67213fe49ae877da76dba5ffa6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Then uncommon colors…[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/2d64c726e0de5bbfaa1a251de0a89f36c75a5e5f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/360dcb25c7aa41adb0e462d9204a6e9f64c63a8a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/20e843c1455cc885adb494a5c1a83360bb5bbb01.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then special colors in cotton candy pink and blue![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/47edf14c9677a8fb846dc7e8e2feaf14797a090c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/b0ab03f23aee340124fdac976a99266e27144d9f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/f3e47f2ec748de946ab154e6dbcf3885cfac554e.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We will be implementing these colors in a later update – we just wanted to give you a sneak peek. You’ll be able to buy these other-colored livestock in shops if you’re lucky, or by breeding the colors through the pregnancy chance board.[/p][p] [/p][p]Unfortunately, the special colored animals won’t give you special-colored yields (e.g., pink wool, strawberry milk, blue eggs, etc.) because we already have so many item definitions in the game – with plenty more to come with additional countries! We will, however, be implementing (ETA undecided) a way to feed certain things to animals to win certain items from their slot machines the next day. For example, feed a rock to a chicken to get omelets, ice cream to a cow to get milkshakes, and so forth. We think this mechanic will be really fun so we’re looking forward to it – we’ve just got so much else to add first![/p][p] [/p][p]The last thing we want to touch on is the pregnancy animation for the cows. If you’re at all confused as to why they’ve been drawn like this, it’s an homage to the very first Harvest Moon on the Super Nintendo (or, in our case, the Gameboy game because it was cheaper to buy and play).[/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://packaged-media.redd.it/njdrxaf5d6db1/pb/m2-res_152p.mp4?m=DASHPlaylist.mpd&v=1&e=1756058400&s=a98075fbe1c355fe069a95d529a8e5fcbb45ee61"]https://packaged-media.redd.it/njdrxaf5d6db1/pb/m2-res_152p.mp4?m=DASHPlaylist.mpd&v=1&e=1756058400&s=a98075fbe1c355fe069a95d529a8e5fcbb45ee61[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]The image of that cow has been burned into our brains since we were children and we thought that it was such a fun detail, let’s include it in our game, too![/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/66475c10d99722cb3e445742a1c0df6c695c54c4.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll have more to discuss with livestock later – especially after we get started on prep for the next country – but we hope you had fun looking at what we plan for them right now.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Log 08.20.25
notes.content:
[p]With the basic tutorials done, we’re free to start moving back to new content additions. Our first new additions are on the small side, but we think they’ll be very helpful and provide a little more variety to gameplay.

We’ve wanted to find a way to organize shop inventories like we’ve organized the general inventory for a while now. For most shops, organization isn’t a problem, but for some of the bigger ones (Tessa’s, for example) it can be a slog to search through to pick out the one item you want.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be introducing product tabs in store inventories to combat this hassle. Now it will be easy to look through cooking utensils, tokens, or whatever you’re interested in.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/cda8344baa752ab1c0bcc542c59ad94f9f4f4439.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Next is a slightly peculiar addition at this time, but it made sense to add it now since we were adding in shopping tabs. From now on, you’ll be able to rent rooms from the inn or hunting lodge on a nightly basis – OR you can buy a tent and go sleep for the night in the north valley.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/cd52ca12a7e760e0173f1adb8c37b2d90654dcd7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added these mechanics for two future reasons: if you don’t have or have demolished your house (some work needs to be done on this before it can be implemented), or you’re staying abroad in another country for the night, week, or month. Of course, it will be a while before the full impact of this addition will be felt.  [/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we’re reintroducing click foraging mechanics into the game. Right now, you can only play slot machines to earn forage items (mushrooms, herbs, etc.), but with this mechanic reintroduced into Reel Life, in select seasons you can click on (slightly hidden) forage items to earn some extra income or ingredients. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rm2yQRHjbKA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You’ll be able to look for mushrooms in Spring, Summer, and Fall; a variety of berries in the Summer; crabapples in the Winter; and extra materials all year long! Of course, you’ll still get higher numbers of these items in slot machines, but we hope this will help add a little spice to gameplay if nothing else.  [/p][p][/p][p]This update will be out soon and following that – basic crafting! Expect to ferment, pickle, jar, refine, and more with our basic crafting update.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and stay tuned for more!  [/p][p]Bad Genes Productions [/p]

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content: [h1]The Reel Life Demo is now available! Yay![/h1][p][/p][h3]You can do everything in the demo that you can in the real game, you just can’t save your progress. So, depending upon time and luck, you can:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Farm a multitude of crops and raise livestock – chickens, sheep, and cows[/p][/*][*][p]Go fishing or hunting after you purchase a fishing rod from Daisy or a rifle from Sean[/p][/*][*][p]Build new buildings on your property – shacks for storage, barns and coops for livestock, or cellars for cold storage[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade your house – from your initial tiny home, upgrade 3 times to reach a large house and multiple rooms for decoration[/p][/*][*][p]Decorate your home and land – purchase furniture, wall coverings, ceiling coverings, and floor coverings from Sasha to make your home just as you like it[/p][/*][*][p]Make new friends – build friendships up with the residents of Rosenvale by gifting them a single item per day (remember to check the journal to see what they like first!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We hope that if you’ve been on the fence about purchasing Reel Life this demo will help to change your mind. Thanks for sticking with us and we hope that you have lots of fun and lots of luck![/h3][h3][/h3]

notes.title: Build 1.0.18 is Out!
notes.content: [h1]Hello and welcome to our big update! [/h1][p][/p][h2]We’ve got a lot of new content for you to enjoy, but we’ll just list the highlights here:[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]New vibrant seasonal color schemes to match the new Slot UI[/p][/*][*][p]An updated, streamlined Slot UI that adds bet lines to slot gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Build coops to house chickens and barns to house cows and sheep[/p][/*][*][p]Start with a one-room home and upgrade it into a large multi-room house[/p][/*][*][p]Fill your new home with furniture and décor purchased from Sasha’s carpenter shop[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve removed the in-game help section and replaced it with an in-depth game guide on the community hub[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]We’re also excited to announce that a Reel Life demo is on the way! [/h3][p]You'll be able do everything in the demo that you can in the real game, but you can’t save. We'll do a separate post for that when it's ready to be released.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Next up, we have a roadmap for the remainder of 2025. [/h3][p]We hope to be able to incorporate all of the below by the end of the year. We’ll be adding these improvements (in or out of this order):[/p][list][*][p]Basic Crafting – the basic crafting system will be used to process raw materials into building materials, an updated cooking system, and machine processing (for processing raw ingredients into finished products, such as jams or spirits)[/p][/*][*][p]Festivals – two festivals per season; a nice break from the monotony of farming wherein you can buy food and special goods[/p][/*][*][p]Mail system – a basic mail system to receive shipping bin receipts or to send/receive letters and gifts from residents of Rosenvale[/p][/*][*][p]Character Customization[/p][/*][*][p]Romance and Marriage – romance residents and get married (or divorced)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h1]Thanks as always for reading and we hope you enjoy the update![/h1]

notes.title: April Progress Update Part II - Build 1.0.18
notes.content:
Hello again! Ready for the preview part II of our upcoming update? We’ll be focusing on slot machines in this one.

First off, we’ve got a brand new streamlined and recolored UI that we’re really happy with. In addition, we’ve added bet lines to add some dynamism to item collection. And for that item collection, all of the basic Rosenvale forage slot machines and items will now be in game – that means all 52 minerals and 64 fish (split between freshwater and saltwater) can now be collected.
Here’s a look at the new UI:

[previewyoutube=wg7D2MxVzYA;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve packed all of the bonus boxes into view now (instead of just having two) and have added paytable and payline information for each slot machine; this will help keep play time concise and fast-paced. In addition, all ‘lose’ symbols have been removed (symbols that when matched have no reward) and have rebalanced return and probability rates.

Another big addition is the livestock ‘pregnancy button’ located on livestock machines. This will allow you to try for pregnancy (with the help of a pregnancy token purchased from Hugo). But more on this below.

The biggest change of all, however, comes with the addition of bet lines for every machine! Cost per bet line varies per machine type, but the center payline is always free. This allows you to continue to play each machine as desired, but you may need to pay a little out of pocket to increase your odds of returns.

[previewyoutube=NbTRemRQ2dc;full][/previewyoutube]

Back to animal pregnancy, you can now expand your ranch naturally rather than through just purchasing new animals. Well, sort of naturally. You’ll need to buy a pregnancy token from Hugo first to be able to play the chance game that will determine a successful pregnancy. New babies can be normal colors or a single special color (at the moment) if you’re lucky. Take a look at the process here:

[previewyoutube=Qq2FN3x5Kko;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve added in some new slot machines, too!

There are now material slot machines, new sprites for the fishing machines, and a tidal pool machine where you can catch non-fish like shrimp, oysters, and clams. Unfortunately, to build new structures and to make upgrades, you’ll need to purchase materials from Sasha as the crafting system to refine materials isn’t in place yet. You can always save up materials for later refinement, though!

We’ve added the full range of fishing rods you can purchase as you’ll need them to play all of the fishing machines. The machines will be split into each type of fish you can catch: tiny, small, medium, large, and extra large; and you’ll need an appropriate fishing rod to play each.

[previewyoutube=2t0jYPUWsTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There will also be three coin slot machines in the back of the pub if you want to try raising income through straight gambling rather than foraging. Bet lines for those are set at 1 gold coin, 5 gold coins, and 25 gold coins for the high rollers. We’re having a lot of fun with these machines and hope you will, too.

[previewyoutube=-pZm16UfvfE;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we’ll be releasing a demo once this update clears the beta process and is posted to the main branch. We’re really excited about it and hope that, if you haven’t purchased the game already, you’ll take a look at it.


Thanks for sticking with us throughout this process (and this long, long post, ha ha). We’ll be posting an updated roadmap alongside the demo, so stay tuned for that.

See you again soon!

notes.title: April Progress Update - Build 1.0.18
notes.content:
Hello again!

Sorry for the radio silence the past couple of months, but we’ve been hard at work on a BIG update. It’s still some time away from posting to beta, but we wanted to check in and highlight a few of the major changes that are on the way! There’s so much to look at, though, we need to split the preview into two posts – here’s Part I.

First up is our color scheme redesign. The slot interface UI has gotten a facelift and new, more exciting color scheme (more on that in Part 2). But in changing that, we needed to pump some more life into surrounding the surrounding environment! So we’ve updated the seasonal colors to better match the neon scheme. We hope you’ll like it!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/557067a0999059cc0598e50c12b89c70e1facae7.png[/img]

We think that the new buildings you can buy from Sasha look great against the new colors, too. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/10863c4997ddc681dabc7cf304555b070b7a48ec.png[/img]

You will now be able build cellars, along with shacks, barns, chicken coops, and upgraded houses! The default house will be replaced with a tiny house that you can upgrade 3 times total. You can also change the appearance of pre-existing buildings, move them around, and demolish them.

[previewyoutube=nvR9uEYBDzg;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=hRg5Wqirswk;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve also updated the shipping bin for better ease of access – now you can transfer items in and out if you change your mind on a sale. You can also easily see how much you’re going to make on each day’s shipment. (See a preview of the new shipping bin in the furniture video later in this post.)

The shipping bin upgrade comes along with initial storage offerings: chests, crates, barrels, and  refrigerators. Use chests, crates, and barrels to store anything you like (except for livestock); and use refrigerators and barrels stored in cellars to hold perishables and keep them from spoiling!

Finally, for Part I of our preview, we have a basic selection of furniture to fill your new buildings (with more to come)! You can buy or commission furniture from Sasha from 3 collections: Basic Furniture (no nonsense furniture that can be found anywhere), Basic Rosenvale Furniture (rustic furniture with a Rosenvale aesthetic), and Comfort Rosenvale Furniture (more homey aesthetics); as well as a large assortment of décor and standalone pieces

[previewyoutube=Cq4L-k1SoGE;full][/previewyoutube]

Buy and collect furniture, wallpaper, flooring, and more to decorate your home to suit your style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/72a6fe0a050be4fe11f4ce5843e084ea77080a74.gif[/img]

That’s it for now – hope you guys enjoyed this little preview. Next time we’ll be looking at the new slot UI, some new slot machines (including the long-awaited cows and sheep), and more!

See you soon! 😊

notes.title: Build 1.0.17 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everybody! We’re ready to push the initial relationship content into the main branch. In case you missed it in the Beta update announcement, here’s what’s going to be in the new update:

[list]
[*]Interior locations – resident homes, shops, Flower Palace, and Flower Temple 1st Floor
[*]Resident schedules – residents will move in between scenes according to their own unique weekly schedules
[*]Zoom feature – you can now zoom in and out
[*]Initial friendship relationship system – gain friendship levels with residents up to level 3
[list]
[*]Each resident relationship level will coincide with a special cut scene to help you get to know that character a little bit better
[*]Once you reach friendship level 3 for each resident (the blue smiley face), you can get a look into their homes for a glimpse into their lifestyles, likes, and dislikes
[/list]
[/list]

Upcoming next in the beta branch will be the building system, material foraging, and an additional livestock sampling.

Player house upgrades are locked until we implement the furniture and crafting systems (up next on the docket), but you will be able to start building and upgrading coops, barns, cellars, and shacks (provided you have enough materials and money).
 
Here we have a small barn being built…
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/20badd84dcd0458cba1b91a77978a91b89fb35b7.png[/img]
And a medium barn being upgraded to a large barn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/eee9bc501e4e59cb33fb9b0efa4034376f0113d3.png[/img]

Fill in your coops with a redesign of the chickens – available initially in three different colors (with many more to follow): 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/370f4117cd3c6a36cb29b8721d354c6f6b908148.png[/img]

And use your barns to house sheep and cows! Sheep will provide wool for later crafting and cows provide milk for energy boosts or cooking.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122222/cfde676cb1804d0e5058a58f9e9fbdf57173cbaa.png[/img]


We’re so excited for all the new content we’ve got coming down the line in the next two months! Thanks for reading, as always, and we’ll see you soon with even more additions to share!

notes.title: Beta Branch is Live!
notes.content:
Happy Saturday!

We've pushed the beta branch to public for anyone that would like to opt in. We'll skip the change list for  now, and just do a quick mention of the major changes you'll see there:

[list]
[*]Resident schedules are now in place - residents will move between locations according to their weekly schedules
[*]Friendship levels can now be earned with residents - give them gifts to increase or decrease their affections
[*]Friendship cutscenes have been implemented up to Level 3 (Level 5 is the max) - view two cutscenes per resident; at Level 3, gain access to further residence areas

Hope you enjoy it! Have a great weekend, all! :)

notes.title: Checking in on the 4th of July
notes.content:
Hello again!
 

We’re working hard at getting the final piece of the relationship system in place for our next upload – the event system. Our next update will be a big one: gifts will be enabled for residents and you’ll be able to start making friends with everyone! We’d like to hold off on romance until we have both the dating marriage systems implemented, so look out for that in future updates.

Once we’ve finished the event system, the game will go into testing mode for a few weeks while we move on to crafting and building. Lots of exciting additions to come in the next few months and we can’t wait to get them out.

We’ll be posting more updates and previews when we can, but we’ll be focusing on getting new game versions out as quickly as possible.

 

Thanks for reading and a happy 4th of July weekend to those of you in the U.S.!

notes.title: State of the Game - End of Apr 2024
notes.content:
Hello again, everyone! Hope you are all doing well. 😊

We aren’t able to provide the update that we were hoping for before the Farming Fest starts (April 29), BUT we have a lot of the foundations built and will be rolling out content in the next few months. 

Here’s a look of what to expect from us in that time:

[h3]1. Relationships and Relationship Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to build friendship and romance levels (as applicable) for residents. Each new friendship level will have a special cutscene per resident.
[/list]
[h3]2. Buildings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to place new buildings on their property, upgrade or delete existing buildings, or move existing buildings.
[*] Buildings will include houses, cellars, storage shacks, barns, and chicken coops.
[*] With new barns come new livestock – cows and sheep in particular.
[/list]
[h3]3. Furniture[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players will be able to fill their new houses and shacks with furniture to help the buildings feel more ‘homey’.
[*] Furniture will be able to be purchased or built from recipes bought from merchants or found in the wild.
[/list]
[h3]4. Crafting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can use existing ingredients to produce goods that will sell for a higher price than their base components.
[*] Craft specialty gifts for NPCs that will provide an extra boost of friendship or romance.
[*] Craft food, furniture, décor, clothing, and more!
[*] Find recipes in the wild – either in the world or won from slot machines!
[/list]
[h3]5. Festivals[/h3]


These are only the main content points we’re aiming for. Additional updates will also contain lots of other little things, like player avatar customization, new places to explore, new slot machines to play, and added interactivity with the world of Reel Life.

As always, we appreciate your patience and hope you’ll really enjoy the new gameplay that’s just around the corner! 


Thanks for sticking with us,

The Bad Genes Productions team

notes.title: State of the Game - 31 Jan 2024
notes.content:
Hello, all! 

We are working on pushing an update this week, but we wanted to talk a little about the state of the game as of the end of the first month.

We’re still pushing little things (this week’s update will include most interiors, lighting, and some slot adjustments) but are prioritizing our time in order to push out as much content as possible by early and mid-April. Our goal is to inject as much ‘stuff to do’ into the game in as little time as possible.

There’s been a little shuffling around of order on the roadmap, but here’s what [b]we’re aiming to get added to the game within the next two months[/b]: 

[h2]Character Customization
[/h2]

Choose your gender, skin color, eye color, hair style, hair color, and starting outfit.

With character customization will come clothing that can be bought, crafted, and switched out whenever you want.

[h2]Basic Crafting and Storage[/h2]

Crafting machines and work benches will be implemented with a basic selection of recipes.

Crafting machines are automatic crafters that take one or more inputs to create one or more outputs (e.g., putting 5 apples in a dehydrator will make 1 dried fruit item). 

We don’t want to talk about each machine here (we’ll do that when they’re added), but you’ll be able to craft things like:

[list]
[*] Baking ingredients (flour, oil, butter, sugar)
[*] Cooking ingredients (mayonnaise, sour cream, jams and jerkies)
[*] Food items (milkshakes, ice cream, juice, yogurt, pickled goods, alcohols)
[*] Materials used for crafting (ingots, glass, lumber, yarn, fabrics)
[/list]
Work benches will have a slightly more in-depth crafting system and a list of recipes to choose from. Use work benches to craft your own furniture, clothing, and bouquets.

Some of these craftable goods will best be used in further crafting or cooking, for giving as gifts, or for making money.

With the crafting system will come storage capabilities and item expiration (for perishables). Food, produce, and flowers will go bad by a certain time if not stored in a cool, dry place - like a refrigerator or in a pine barrel in your cellar.

[h2]Buildings
[/h2]

From the carpenter shop, you will be able to build, upgrade, move, and demolish buildings.
Some of the buildings that will be available are:

[list]
[*] Player Houses – in tiny, small, medium, and 3 large configurations
[*] Chicken Coops
[*] Barns
[*] Shacks (use for crafting machinery and chests if you are low on space, for example)
[*] Cellars (best used for perishable storage and crafting machinery)
[/list]
[h2]Furniture
[/h2]

All of these new buildings are going to start out empty. Fill them with moveable and removeable furniture in a grid-based system.

Furniture will not be locked to specific areas within each building, so if you want a house filled with nothing but toilets, you are free to do you.

Furniture can be placed inside buildings or around your farm – provided there’s enough space.

With the advent of a moveable and removeable bed, you will also be able to sleep and save at the city inn or hamlet hunting lodge if you don’t have a bed in your house.

[h2]Relationships and Relationship Events
[/h2]

You will finally be able to give gifts to residents and increase (or decrease) your friendship and relationship levels with each.

Drag items onto the friendship gift box to affect their friendship levels or onto the romance gift box (only available with romanceable residents) to affect their romance levels.

With each friendship level gained (up to a maximum of 5), there will be an opportunity to view a resident cutscene. While they vary from resident to resident, cutscenes will include one or more of the following:

[list]
[*] More information about the resident and/or their backstory
[*] The opportunity to further increase or decrease affection
[*] A special gift!
[/list]
Residents will also start moving around the world of Reel Life, so you might need to check the map from time to time until you get used to their schedule.

Any remaining interiors will also be added to the game (resident home areas, the Flower Palace, the Flower Temple).



We’re really excited about all the new stuff coming down the pipeline and will be working at supersonic speed to get it out, so keep checking back for updates!

The goal is to keep updating with new info as we progress, but updates and posts might be irregular for a while. As always, thank you for your patience as we continue to add more to the game.


Thanks for playing! 😊

notes.title: We're Live!
notes.content:
Features are currently quite limited, but we’ll be working hard on getting updated content out to you as fast as we can! Our initial working build will let you get a feel for the game and its characters while stockpiling funds to use in future updates.

We plan to publish monthly communications to keep you updated on our progress, but most of our time and effort will be spent pumping out additional content and features. Some updates will have small aesthetic changes, while others will have big additions to the world.

We ask that you please be patient with us as we introduce content, adjust in-game systems (payouts, items costs, etc.), and iron out any bugs.


Here is our (conservatively estimated) roadmap for the remaining big features of the base game:


[b]Q1 2024
[/b][list]
